title: Sequencing a digital scholarly editing / TEI curriculum
query: In what sequence should a digital scholarly editing curriculum teach cataloguing, transcription, normalization, collation, TEI markup, annotation, and publication, and what evidence supports that ordering?

title: Manual-before-tool scaffolding in humanities computing pedagogy
query: Does teaching students to perform a textual scholarship task manually before introducing automated software improve conceptual understanding, and what does research on scaffolding and fading say about tool-based humanities instruction?

title: Teaching HTR and Transkribus to undergraduates
query: What pedagogical practices are effective when teaching handwritten text recognition and Transkribus to undergraduate students in manuscript studies courses?

title: LLM and AI-assisted methods in digital humanities teaching
query: How are large language models and AI coding assistants being integrated into digital humanities and textual criticism teaching, and what are the documented benefits and risks for student learning?

title: Project-based cumulative assessment in digital humanities courses
query: How effective is cumulative project-based assessment, where each weekly assignment is a stage of a single scholarly digital edition, compared with independent weekly assignments in digital humanities courses?

title: Cognitive load and weekly deadline rhythm in technical courses
query: What does research on cognitive load and spacing say about how much time students need between learning a new technical method and submitting graded work using it?
